title: fix(core)!: every door that admits an API key hands its client facts to the credential_use row (#31898)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi96J56WX3vqJhhUNGr9DWSVD)_

Fixes #31898

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — `RequestExecutionContextInput.transport` (`@objectstack/core`) becomes a required key typed `{ remoteAddress } | undefined`. Measured: on base a `resolveRequestExecutionContext` call without `transport` compiles; on head it is `TS2741` (the forced test changes below are exactly those call sites). Which credentials any door admits does not change.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill or doc names `RequestExecutionContextInput` or its keys; the changeset's upgrade note carries the migration (ADR-0087 `runtime-interface-only`, verified by `check:adr-0087-registration`).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：所有能放行 API key 的入口（共 13 处）现在都把请求的对端地址和请求头交给认证服务的信任规则，`credential_use` 审计行记下地址和 user agent，不再写 `not_supplied`；`transport` 成为必填键。
- 为什么改：#31821 只接好了 REST、`/mcp`、stdio 三处，其余入口用 key 时审计行没有来源地址，泄露的 key 从新地址使用也看不出来。
- 风险与回滚：只补审计行的值，不改任何放行判定；地址只来自 `resolveClientAddress` 一条信任规则，没有入口自己读 `X-Forwarded-For`。回滚即撤销本 PR。对 TS 调用方是编译期破坏（漏传 `transport` 报 TS2741）。
- 先看：`packages/core/src/security/credential-use-client.ts`（唯一的 helper）和 `credential-use-client-doors.pin.test.ts`（普查）。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/core && npx vitest run --project repo src/security/credential-use-client-doors.pin.test.ts src/security/own-row-delete-routes.test.ts`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位验收即可。

## What changes

- **One core helper.** `credentialUseClientFor(authService, { headers, remoteAddress })` in `packages/core/src/security/credential-use-client.ts` is the only place that asks `IAuthService.resolveClientAddress` (the trust rule). `resolveRequestExecutionContext` and the six doors that call `resolveAuthzContext` / `resolveApiKeyAdmission` directly all use it. `transportPeerAddressOf(c)` reads a raw Hono app's socket peer the way the adapter does.
- **`transport` is required** on `RequestExecutionContextInput`, typed `{ remoteAddress } | undefined`.
- **13 door sites wired**, each handing only its transport's own peer address:
  - storage: the ADR-0069 gate reader (`resolveApiKeyAdmission` 7th argument), the download authorizer and the upload attacher;
  - service-settings settings routes; plugin-sharing shareable-objects list and share-link routes; service-messaging preference options; service-datasource admin routes; service-print print route;
  - core own-row delete routes (a door not on the card's list, found by the step-0 recount);
  - plugin-auth organization settings caller; cloud-connection status/setup access (`holdsPlatformSettings`); cloud-connection marketplace local install.
- **Four session-only sites** (plugin-auth second org-scope read, plugin-hono-server current-user endpoints, plugin-webhooks redeliver entitlement, cloud-connection runtime config) read no key and write no row; they state `transport: undefined`.
- ⛔ No door reads `X-Forwarded-For` or `X-Real-IP`; `client-address.ts` is unchanged. No path that cannot reach a request remains: every key door now hands its facts.

## Tests

- **Census** `packages/core/src/security/credential-use-client-doors.pin.test.ts` (registered in `vitest.repo-tests.json`): every caller of the three seams (plus `resolveApiKeyPrincipal`, which has no caller) is classified at its exact count; every door call hands facts; every session-only call is really session-only; every door names a pin. Calls are read through `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs` (declared in `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`), so a `/*` inside a template opens no phantom comment.
- **Per-door pins** (each asserts the trust rule is handed peer `10.0.0.5` and the raw forwarded header, and the stamp equals the established address with the user agent): new `core/src/security/own-row-delete-routes.test.ts`, new `service-storage/src/storage-credential-use-client.test.ts` (3 doors), and added cases in service-settings `settings-routes.api-key-account-posture.pin.test.ts`, plugin-sharing `shareable-objects.test.ts` and `share-link-routes.api-key-account-posture.pin.test.ts`, service-messaging `preference-options-routes.integration.test.ts`, service-datasource `admin-routes-api-key-account-posture.pin.test.ts`, service-print `print-routes.test.ts`, plugin-auth `allowed-ip-ranges.pin.test.ts` (real `AuthManager` trust rule), cloud-connection `marketplace-install-local-api-key-account-posture.pin.test.ts` and `cloud-connection-setup-access.pin.test.ts`.
- **Forced test changes** (the key became required, each adds `transport: undefined` or an explicit transport; no assertion changed): core `request-execution-context.test.ts` (`input()` baseline); plugin-audit `credential-use-audit.integration.test.ts` (REST and MCP door rows, and `compose` now states its transport); plugin-auth `one-account-per-request.test.ts`; plugin-hono-server `current-user-endpoints.resolver-wirings.pin.test.ts` (`DOOR_PARAMETERS`); runtime `request-execution-context.conformance.test.ts` (5 row params).
- Gate-driven test edits: the storage pin's engine double opens `findOne` with `assertEngineFindOnePredicate` and refuses a `$` combinator (`check:engine-double-contract`, `check:where-matcher`; `engine-double-contract.pinned.json` learns the new pin); the datasource pin loads `@objectstack/driver-sql` at collection (`check:test-source-alias`).

## Acceptance notes

- Step-0 recount: 13 key-admitting sites to wire (12 on the card + own-row delete); 4 card-listed sites are session-only and admit no key.
- No single seam holds the request: the shared funnel (`resolveAuthzContext` → admission) holds headers only. Hence one helper plus per-door peer handover (seat rulings 1–3).
- plugin-hono-server's adapter and plugin-auth keep their own peer readers; core `transportPeerAddressOf` is new, used by the two cloud-connection Hono doors.
- The storage pin is a new file because it needs a module mock of `registerStorageFamily` to reach the three package-internal closures.
- **Ablations** (each restored, `git diff HEAD` empty, core dist rebuilt and preflighted for dist-resolved suites):
  - seam drops the address (`credentialUseClientFor` returns no address): all 13 door pins red (core 1, settings 1, storage 3, cloud-connection 2, sharing 2, datasource 1, print 1, messaging 1, plugin-auth 1);
  - a door drops its `transport` (shareable-objects): census red naming the file;
  - the census loses a door's entry (print-routes): census red naming it as unclassified; a wrong call count: census red.
- **CONTROL** (REST, `/mcp`, stdio unchanged): rest `rest-api-key-lifecycle.pin` + `rest-api-key-account-posture.pin`, runtime `src/security/` (incl. `resolve-execution-context` and the conformance suite), mcp `plugin-execution-context` + `stdio-api-key-account-posture.pin` + `stdio-agent-account`, plugin-audit `credential-use-audit.integration` — all green.

## Verification

All on head `7ef3c981` (branch merged with `origin/main`, which moved `auth-plugin.ts` and `storage-service-plugin.ts`; the merge was clean), heavy runs under `os-verify-lock`:

- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 96 commands, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 96 derived, 96 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `tsc --noEmit` on the 13 touched packages: all exit 0. Root ESLint (`--no-inline-config`) over the 13 package dirs: exit 0 (the packages have no `lint` script of their own).
- Package suites: core `src/security/` 1308/1308, plugin-auth 4508 (+10 skipped), storage 1439, settings 1431, sharing 1510, messaging 876, datasource 1300, print 119, cloud-connection 1146, hono-server 484, webhooks 262, mcp 1027, runtime `src/security/` 213, plugin-audit credential-use 22.
- Full dogfood (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`): Test Files 443 passed, 3 skipped (446); Tests 3674 passed, 42 skipped (3716); lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- One file-level failure seen once under the lock: service-print `chromium-driver.test.ts` (its browser-launch hook; no test failed, and this PR does not touch it). It passed on three reruns.
